counts_only.description: Per-floor count badges only on the exterior.

operational_only.description: Show operational workers externally; SIM hidden.

all_workers_visible.description: Show all workers including SIM externally (legacy view).

policy_note: Default counts_only stops the spiral/band of label spam. The previous swarm came from rendering one SVG dot + label for each of the 64 legacy /api/unified.workers[] entries.
